pages.text: Every $(item)3 seconds$(), each block of a burning firebox takes $(item)50 mB$() of fuel from the shared tank. A 3 x 3 firebox therefore burns 450 mB every 3 seconds.

It only burns while it holds at least the server setting $(item)fireboxFuelConsumption$() of fuel, $(item)100 mB$() by default. Below that it goes out and goggles show $(item)Not enough fuel to burn$(). Keep a pump feeding it rather than filling it once.

$(l)Exhaust$()$(br)With the server setting $(item)fireboxExhaustRequirement$() on (the default), each block also puts $(item)500 mB of carbon dioxide$() into the exhaust tank every 3 seconds, about 167 mB per second per block.
When the exhaust tank is full, the firebox stops and goggles show $(item)Exhaust full: pump the CO2 away$(). So every firebox needs a way out for its CO2:

$(li)attach a mechanical pump to the firebox and pull the CO2 out through pipes,$(li)send it to an $(item)exhaust$() or a $(item)smokestack$() that vents it into the air,$(li)or keep it in tanks for later use.$(br2)Fuel can be pumped in, and only CO2 can be pumped out.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
